name: BURSA
recent: Bursa Malaysia 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，另有公司秘书及主要高管变动。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收同比增长 25.5%，净利同比增长 23.0%。新闻方面，马股大盘 FBM KLCI 跌至 14 个月低点。
notable: 最新季度（2026年9月30日止）营收同比增长 25.5%，净利同比增长 23.0%。
公司秘书 Dato' Sabrina Albakri Binti Abu Bakar 及 Yong Hazadurah Binti Md Hashim 先后变更。
主要高管 Ravinder Singh A/L Bachan Singh 变动。
risks: EPF 在近期多份公告中申报股东权益变动。
新闻显示 FBM KLCI 跌至 14 个月低点。
earnings: 2026年9月30日止季度营收 MYR 209.182 million，环比增长 2.1%，同比增长 25.5%；净利 MYR 70.206 million，环比下降 2.2%，同比增长 23.0%；净利率 33.6%，低于上一季度的 35.0%。

recent_en: Bursa Malaysia's recent announcements mainly comprise EPF's substantial shareholder changes, along with changes of company secretary and a principal officer. For the latest quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue rose 25.5% YoY and net profit rose 23.0% YoY. In the news, the FBM KLCI fell to a 14-month low.
notable_en: Latest quarter ended 30 September 2026: revenue up 25.5% YoY and net profit up 23.0% YoY.
Changes of company secretary involving Dato' Sabrina Albakri Binti Abu Bakar and Yong Hazadurah Binti Md Hashim.
Change in principal officer Ravinder Singh A/L Bachan Singh.
risks_en: EPF reported changes in its substantial shareholder interest in multiple recent announcements.
News reports show the FBM KLCI fell to a 14-month low amid broad-based selling.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was MYR 209.182 million, up 2.1% QoQ and up 25.5% YoY; net profit was MYR 70.206 million, down 2.2% QoQ and up 23.0% YoY; net margin was 33.6%, lower than 35.0% in the previous quarter.
